description:
Launch Window: June 4th from 4:00AM to 8:00AM EDT (8:00-12:00 UTC)
Current T0: June 3rd at 5:53:00AM EDT (9:53:00 UTC)

Mission: Falcon 9 launch of 29 Starlink v2 Mini satellites into orbit.
Launch location: Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Earth.
Target orbit: Low-Earth Orbit (LEO); 247x256km 53.16º orbit
Booster: B1090-12; 77d 20h 43min 26s turnaround
Booster History: O3b mPOWER E, Crew-10, Bandwagon-3, SL 6-67, SL 10-18, O3b mPOWER D, CRS-33, SL 10-59, SL 6-79, SL 6-103, SL 10-46.
Satellites launched: 184, will be 213 after this mission.
Booster recovery: A Shortfall Of Gravitas (ASOG)
Fairing recovery: Bob
Rocket trajectory: Northeast flying parallel to the US east coast
Payload mass: Approximately 17 tonnes.
Stats:
  - SpaceX's 674th launch overall.
  - SpaceX's 65th launch of the year.
  - SpaceX's 1st launch of the month.
  - Earth's 127th orbital launch of the year.
  - Falcon's 293rd launch since the last failure.
